verdict.rationale: Framework SDKs and edge middleware are a fair thing to ask of an identity provider like Keycloak, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no first-party Next.js (or peer framework) SDK or middleware, and nothing about verifying sessions at the edge. The only related material is standard OIDC endpoints, the well-known configuration, and token introspection. Those are developer building blocks, not a shipped framework integration, so they earn no credit.
